title: Uploaded image deletion policy decision
purpose: Record two competing stakeholder requests about what happens when an image owner selects Delete, and hold the behavior choice for a human decision.

scope.text: Two competing requests exist for the behavior of Delete on an uploaded image: immediate permanent deletion and 30-day owner recoverability.

requirements.text: Privacy stakeholder requests immediate permanent deletion of an uploaded image when its owner selects Delete.
Support stakeholder requests that the same deleted image remain recoverable by its owner for 30 days after Delete.

stories.text: If a human selects the immediate permanent deletion policy, an image owner can select Delete and have the uploaded image permanently deleted immediately.
acceptance_criteria: Given a human has selected the immediate permanent deletion policy, when the image owner selects Delete, then the uploaded image is permanently deleted immediately.

stories.text: If a human selects the 30-day owner recoverability policy, an image owner can select Delete and the image remains recoverable by that owner for 30 days.
acceptance_criteria: Given a human has selected the 30-day owner recoverability policy, when the image owner selects Delete, then the image remains recoverable by that owner for 30 days after Delete.

dependencies.text: No stakeholder has authority to choose between these requests yet.

risks.text: Satisfying the immediate permanent deletion request would leave the 30-day owner recoverability request unmet; satisfying the 30-day recoverability request would leave the immediate permanent deletion request unmet.

success_metrics.text: After a human selects a policy, verify by observation of the Delete behavior that it matches the acceptance criteria of the selected alternative.

open_questions: Which policy should a human select: immediate permanent deletion on Delete, or 30-day owner recoverability after Delete?
Who has authority to select between the two requests?
